svg.title: How homeprod is put together
svg.desc: Nothing comes in from the internet. Visitors to this site reach GitHub Pages, and the Forgejo runner on docker-pi, a Raspberry Pi 5, pushes each build out to it. Traefik on docker-pi serves homepage to the LAN. Admin access comes over the tailnet to a two-node Proxmox cluster running media, photo, document and Git services. Komodo Periphery on docker-pi reports to Komodo Core on the cluster, and the cluster backs up to a separate Proxmox Backup Server.
